title: Underwater Torch
description:
Place all torches underwater and they will still emit light
Full Fabric 1.20.1 + 1.21.1 + 1.21.4
body:
# Underwater Torches

_Does it also bother you that you can't place torches underwater?_

**This Mod fixes the problem!**

---

**Underwater Torches** is a **lightweight Fabric mod** that allows you to place all types of torches underwater. Torches will stay lit and continue to emit light even when submerged!

### Features:

- Place regular torches, soul torches, redstone torches, and all their wall variants underwater
- Torches emit their normal light level even when waterlogged
- **Fully compatible** with **server and client** – required on both sides 
- **Full Fabric 1.20.1 + 1.21.1 + 1.21.4 support**

### How it changes your experience:

- Light up ocean monuments, underwater caves, and shipwrecks with regular torches
- No more need for sea lanterns or glowstone just to see underwater
- Build underwater bases with proper torch lighting, just like on land
- Redstone torches work underwater too, enabling submerged redstone builds
